newsitem.title: CHINA: Prudential UK launches $1 billion Asia fund.
newsitem.headline: Prudential UK launches $1 billion Asia fund.

text.p: Prudential Corp of the United Kingdom said on Tuesday it has set a $1 billion target for a fund which would make direct investments in Asia's emerging markets.
The "Prudential InvestDirect Asia Fund" will start off at the beginning of 1997 with an initial funding of $150 million, Prudential said.
Topping the list of countries are China, India and Vietnam, it said.
"We know it is right to now invest in the development capital asset class in these exciting markets," said Peter Davis, group chief executive of Prudential.
The new fund would provide development capital for infrastructure projects and for growing companies, it said.
The source of funds would be from Prudential's own business in the United Kingdom and Asia, it said.
